Federal funding received by universities in 2022-2023. Columbia received around $1.2 billion from federal sources in the 2022-2023 academic year. The University of California, San Diego, received $1.1 billion in federal funding in 2022–23.

Percentage impacts of budget cuts and funding sources. A 25 percent reduction in public research and development spending would shrink the U.S. GDP by 3.8 percent. The CDC budget would be cut by 53%. 42% of Johns Hopkins' total revenue in 2022–23 came from federal sources. Some universities benefitted from a 60% indirect cost payment.
NIH project and staff reductions. NIH slashed nearly 800 projects. 1,200 staff members were let go from the NIH earlier this month. The NIH has terminated or delayed over 2,000 grant awards.
